setup: Put the phone upright at waist height. Walk about two metres away and face the phone, with nothing in your hands. Hold your arms straight and a little out to the sides, like an upside-down V.
turn: Now turn slowly to your left, all the way round, keeping your arms still. You have twenty seconds.
done: Done. You can come back to the phone.
whole_body: Make sure your whole body, from head to feet, is in view.
not_seen: I can't see you. Stand in front of the phone.
arms_up: Lift your arms a little away from your body, like an upside-down V.
arms_down: Lower your arms a little, to about halfway.
stay_centre: Stay in the middle of the picture while you turn.
